modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person

modules.module_title: Maintain Health and Hygiene

pcs.pc_description: ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately

modules.module_title: Effective waste management practices

pcs.pc_description: ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste

modules.module_title: Material/energy conservation practices

pcs.pc_description: ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Develop/Interpret e-plan, layout and drawings

pcs.pc_description: prepare/interpret the project design by obtaining information from mechanical drawings and layout diagram
prepare design of electrical wiring, schematic diagram and project documentation as per organizational SOP and guidelines
prepare the e-plan consists of layout, mechanical drawings and project execution phases as per work instructions

identify and select the automation elements in align with electrical, mechanical and environmental parameters like power, response time, inbuilt protections, dimension, weight, package, thermal characteristics etc. as per the e- plan and required specifications
decide on the core and auxiliary support process as per specifications & drawings
plan and administer automation project as per the e-plan

modules.module_title: Perform installation and integration of the automation system

pcs.pc_description: mount and place the electrical and mechanical components safely as per design and project document
route electrical wires, make wiring connections etc. as per the wiring diagram and SOP
perform assembly of the system components like D.C. valve, cylinder assembly etc. as per the mechanical drawings and SOP
perform the pre-commissioning to ensure proper functionality of installed automation components
carry out the various integration activities like programming, wiring with external elements etc. as per design document and SOP
develop HMI screen for system monitoring controls like process, alarm and maintenance of automation system
do the necessary parameter setting to drive conveyor motor with VFD
start the automation system, look for any warnings/errors in it and rectify the same as per organizational guidelines
perform all necessary tests and procedures required as per industry standards
perform dry-run of the automation system with the existing manufacturing process

modules.module_title: Carry out maintenance of automation system

pcs.pc_description: prepare maintenance schedule and checklist for conducting the preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance of the automation system
generate the fallback action plan for failures of critical activities
identify the critical spares with the help of supplier, maintenance team and plan for their availability
develop the maintenance manual with the help of supplier and maintenance team

modules.module_title: Perform post-installation activities

pcs.pc_description: conduct the trials of automation system as per the e-plan to align it with existing or new manufacturing process
handover the system to production team & train them on it as per organizational guidelines and procedures
prepare documents and records such as experience under development, TGW /TGR faced during process trials etc. as a reference for future development

modules.module_title: Interpret the component/fixture design

pcs.pc_description: identify the work requirements and work to be done by interpreting the component/fixture design
identify and select software like CATIA, Auto- CAD, Fusion 360 etc. for creating the designs and models as per the project document
collate the design requirements in terms of material used for making the component, packaging and other requirements to decide the dimensions, measurements and tolerances of the aggregate/component

modules.module_title: Design the object model using Computer Aided Design software

pcs.pc_description: develop and design specifications of the component by using the Geometric and Trigonometric rules/formula as per project document
set the required unit and dimension parameters and insert sketches, scanned images, diagrams, signs or symbols, etc. of required product design in a CAD file
create a 3D model of product by using CAD techniques as per the information received from the Project Document
prepare layouts and various views of drawing to generate a relationship between components and assemblies
convert the object model into STL or AMF file format as per the 3D printer requirement
check object model files for common errors such as holes, self-intersections, manifold errors, faces etc. and rectify the same by following organizational recommended procedures

modules.module_title: Perform 3D printing operations

pcs.pc_description: select suitable 3D printing machine as per specified machine specifications (i.e. build speed, extrusion speed, nozzle temperature) and raw material to print the components as per product specifications
set the 3D printing machine and its parameters such as room temperature range, air cleanliness as per SOP/WI
select and upload the standard tesselation language (.stl) code file needed for machine operation
pre-heat the bed of the machine to adequate temperature as per process specifications
set the laser or nozzles temperature to defined values as per process specification
start the 3D printing machine and perform 3D printing operations as per SOP/WI
inspect the printed part as per the project document for required quality and if non- conforming, take action as per organizational guidelines
store & preserve the printed parts manufactured as per organizational guidelines and procedures
